# Objective

Implement G9X1 truthful extended DXF curve export on
`feature/g9x1-extended-dxf-curves`.

**PROPOSED FUTURE PROMPT — UNEXECUTED AND NOT AUTHORIZED.**

# Mandatory entry gate

Require the normative DXF fidelity spec, Accepted ADR 0014, green G5 and
G6–G8 internal semantic authority, clean branch, exact prompt hash and composed
PASS. G9U0 PASS is deliberately not a hard entry condition.

# Hard dependencies

G5 exact-export authority and the author-approved internal G6–G8 Locus semantic
contracts are hard dependencies. G9U0, G9A, G9U1, G9B/C and G9O1 are not
semantic dependencies of the export adapter.

# Recommended execution predecessor

Execute after G9U0 when practical so X1 can consume the public semantic adapter
and share lifecycle evidence; this is scheduling advice, not an authorization
edge. G9O1-first remains the operational recommendation.

# Global/release gate

G9X1 joins G9U0 as a hard input to G9U1 and must pass the integrated global G9
closeout. An X1 PASS alone authorizes neither U1 nor release.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Read current export adapter/model/writer/controller/tests and G5 corpus first,
then the approved DXF proposal, internal G6–G8 semantic source, any available
G9U0 public adapter, and the validation plan.

# Scope

Stage X1A fidelity outcomes/preflight/conditional-sidecar/paired writes and the executable G5 corpus,
then X1B approved bounded adaptive Locus V2/function/parametric/conic polylines
with semantic domains, gaps, deterministic budgets and honest guarantees.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

No temporary `GeoElement`, construction/protocol mutation, render/viewport
sampling, legacy locus sampling, silent partial output, unsupported implicit
contouring, unproved exact SPLINE, G9 spatial or command semantics.

# Editable boundaries

GeoCeDG export packages/controller, build provenance, regression corpus/tests,
focused verifier, docs/evidence and minimum registered seams only.

# Productive versus test-private permissions

X1A/X1B approved export behavior is productive and experimental. SPLINE/reader
or implicit probes remain test-private unless separately authorized.

# Architectural placement

Semantic geometry remains kernel authority. Approximation builder and sidecar
are read-only export services; writer only encodes validated DTOs.

# Required design/specification

Implement component fidelity/reasons/guarantees, explicit semantic domains,
deterministic dyadic refinement, preflight defaults, conditional mandatory
sidecar fields and paired failure policy. Approved typed curve families may use
their approved approximation strategy as normal behavior only when UI/report
identify the result as approximate. Strict reject/stop is the partiality
default; any future partial option requires explicit user intent, visible
warning, and a mandatory sidecar. Every approximation, omission, partial or
unsupported-not-exported component, work-limit termination, or other fidelity
reduction requires a sidecar; an all-exact export may omit it.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Preserve branch/component multiplicity, invalid gaps, orientation, established
periodic closure and unbounded-domain truth. Never claim a stronger error bound
than evidence establishes.

# Compatibility and serialization

Preserve exact G5 mappings and `.ggb` semantics. Sidecar schema is versioned;
source identity scope is disclosed. Export never persists approximation.

# Required tests and commands

Execute the G5 corpus end to end; analytic/branch/gap/domain/work/stale/scale/
viewport invariants; approximate-normal visibility; exact-only optional-sidecar;
every mandatory-sidecar trigger; strict default rejection and explicit partial
intent/warning; controller collisions/failures; deterministic DXF+manifest;
external-reader evidence where applicable. Run focused G9X1 and composed verify.

# Required artifacts

Source/tests/corpus, schema examples, benchmark counters, reader evidence,
focused verifier, traceability and staged reports.

# Stop conditions

Stop on render dependence, hidden construction objects, nondeterministic work,
unreported omission/approximation, or inability to preserve exact G5 output.
